== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|A Forger is a type of [[sacred artist]] who specializes in the manipulation and shaping of [[madra]] into physical or illusionary forms. This discipline is closely related to [[Soulsmithing]], as both involve taking control of power to give it structure. While [[Soulsmiths]] focus on working with the essence of spirits and [[dead matter]] to create functional [[constructs]], Forgers utilize techniques to manifest various effects ranging from defensive barriers to offensive weaponry. Forgers follow different [[Paths]], which dictate the nature of their abilities. Those on the [[Path of the White Fox]] utilize the [[Fox Mirror technique]] to create highly detailed illusions made of light and [[dreams]]. These deceptions can mimic reality—such as false walls, clothing, or even duplicates of people—but they lack physical substance and can be easily destroyed. Other Forgers, such as those on the [[Path]] of the [[Mountain's Heart]], can conjure solid [[constructs]] like weapons or crushing tools. Advanced [[Forging]] techniques allow artists to create complex objects, such as flying swords, multiple weapon echoes, or even [[constructs]] that appear to possess life. The hammer serves as the symbolic badge for those in this discipline.}}
